ex.en: Have you finished writing your thesis?
ex.zh: 你的論文寫完了嗎？

ex.en: Are you preparing for your thesis defense?
ex.zh: 你在準備論文答辯嗎？

ex.en: The defense of the master thesis is just happening next month.
ex.zh: 下個月就要碩士論文口試了。

ex.en: I won't try to refute your theses.
ex.zh: 我不會試圖反駁你的論點。

ex.en: The main thesis of the book is simple.
ex.zh: 這本書的主要論點很簡單。

ex.en: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.
ex.zh: 這個理論對我來說太難懂了。

ex.en: I can't find a single flaw in his theory.
ex.zh: 我在他的理論中找不到任何問題。

ex.en: John Dalton was the creator of the atomic theory.
ex.zh: 約翰．道耳頓是原子論的創立者。

ex.en: I don't want to hear your theories.
ex.zh: 我不想聽你的理論。

ex.en: My friend believes conspiracy theories; should I try to prove him wrong?
ex.zh: 我朋友相信陰謀論，我該試著證明他是錯的嗎？

ex.en: In theory, the plan should work.
ex.zh: 理論上，這個計畫應該行得通。

ex.en: It sounds good in theory, but it's hard in practice.
ex.zh: 理論上聽起來不錯，實際上卻很難。

ex.en: The police carried out a thorough investigation.
ex.zh: 警方進行了徹底的調查。

ex.en: Please give the report a thorough check before sending it.
ex.zh: 寄出前請把報告仔細檢查一遍。

ex.en: She is very thorough in her work.
ex.zh: 她做事非常仔細周到。

ex.en: His house is cleaned thoroughly once a week.
ex.zh: 他家每週徹底打掃一次。

ex.en: Read the contract thoroughly before you sign it.
ex.zh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀合約。

ex.en: I thoroughly regretted staying up so late, come morning.
ex.zh: 到了早上，我非常後悔昨晚熬夜到那麼晚。

ex.en: They got thoroughly wet in the rain.
ex.zh: 他們在雨中淋得全身溼透。

ex.en: You can't accuse him of theft without having proof.
ex.zh: 沒有證據，你不能指控他偷竊。

ex.en: The police accused him of theft.
ex.zh: 警方指控他犯了竊盜罪。

ex.en: Betty has a previous conviction for theft.
ex.zh: 貝蒂有竊盜前科。

ex.en: Feel free to get yourself a drink if you are thirsty.
ex.zh: 如果口渴，就自己倒杯飲料吧。

ex.en: I was quite thirsty and wanted to drink something cool.
ex.zh: 我很渴，想喝點冰涼的東西。

ex.en: It looks like your dog is thirsty.
ex.zh: 你的狗看起來好像渴了。

ex.en: The young team is thirsty for success.
ex.zh: 這支年輕的團隊渴望成功。

ex.en: Students are thirsty for practical knowledge.
ex.zh: 學生們渴望獲得實用的知識。

thrill.zh: 使興奮（be thrilled 非常高興）

ex.en: Fred was thrilled to buy the car.
ex.zh: 佛瑞德很興奮地買了那輛車。

ex.en: I'd be thrilled to do that.
ex.zh: 我非常樂意這麼做。

ex.en: Tom is thrilled.
ex.zh: 湯姆興奮極了。

ex.en: Skydiving gave him the thrill of his life.
ex.zh: 跳傘讓他體驗了這輩子最刺激的感受。

ex.en: Many people travel for the thrill of adventure.
ex.zh: 很多人旅行是為了冒險的刺激感。

ex.en: We changed suppliers, thereby reducing costs by 10%.
ex.zh: 我們換了供應商，因而降低了一成成本。

ex.en: He signed the contract, thereby accepting all its terms.
ex.zh: 他簽了合約，也就等於接受了所有條款。

ex.en: Tom has a high threshold for pain.
ex.zh: 湯姆對疼痛的忍受度很高。

ex.en: Orders above this threshold get free shipping.
ex.zh: 超過這個門檻的訂單免運費。

ex.en: Your income is below the tax threshold.
ex.zh: 你的收入低於課稅門檻。

ex.en: He paused at the threshold of the room.
ex.zh: 他在房門口停了下來。

ex.en: She stood on the threshold, waiting.
ex.zh: 她站在門口等著。

ex.en: Small businesses thrive in this area.
ex.zh: 小型企業在這一帶蓬勃發展。

ex.en: Some people thrive under pressure.
ex.zh: 有些人在壓力下反而表現更好。

ex.en: The plants are thriving in the sun.
ex.zh: 這些植物在陽光下長得很好。

ex.en: Thereafter we heard no more from him.
ex.zh: 從那之後，我們再也沒有他的消息。

ex.en: He joined the company in 2010 and was promoted shortly thereafter.
ex.zh: 他 2010 年進公司，不久之後就升職了。

thumb.zh: 拇指；thumbs up 豎起大拇指（表示讚）

ex.en: I cut my thumb while cooking.
ex.zh: 我煮飯時割傷了拇指。

ex.en: My manager gave me a thumbs up.
ex.zh: 主管對我豎起了大拇指。

thumb.zh: rule of thumb：經驗法則、大原則

ex.en: As a rule of thumb, you should plan on one pound of beef for every two guests.
ex.zh: 一般原則是，每兩位客人要準備一磅牛肉。

ex.en: As a rule of thumb, save 10% of your income.
ex.zh: 一個基本原則是把收入的一成存起來。

thumb.zh: green thumb：很會種植物、園藝高手

ex.en: My grandmother has a green thumb.
ex.zh: 我祖母很會種花種草。

ex.en: You need a green thumb to grow these plants.
ex.zh: 要種好這些植物得有一雙巧手。

ex.en: That is my manager over there.
ex.zh: 那邊那位是我的主管。

ex.en: Who told you that?
ex.zh: 誰跟你說的？

ex.en: That way I kill two birds with one stone.
ex.zh: 這樣我就一舉兩得了。

ex.en: Can you pass me that file?
ex.zh: 可以把那份檔案遞給我嗎？

ex.en: I think that you ought to apologize to her.
ex.zh: 我認為你應該向她道歉。

ex.en: It seems to me that the train is late.
ex.zh: 火車好像誤點了。

ex.en: Check that your username and password are written correctly.
ex.zh: 檢查一下帳號和密碼有沒有輸入正確。

ex.en: This is the report that I mentioned yesterday.
ex.zh: 這就是我昨天提到的那份報告。

ex.en: The company that hired me is in Taipei.
ex.zh: 雇用我的那家公司在台北。

ex.en: It's not that difficult.
ex.zh: 沒有那麼難。

ex.en: I didn't know it was that expensive.
ex.zh: 我不知道它那麼貴。

ex.en: This is a store that caters specially to students.
ex.zh: 這是一家專門服務學生的商店。

ex.en: "This is what I was looking for!" he exclaimed.
ex.zh: 「這就是我在找的東西！」他大叫。

ex.en: You have to get this work finished by noon.
ex.zh: 你必須在中午前完成這項工作。

ex.en: How did you come up with this crazy idea?
ex.zh: 你是怎麼想出這個瘋狂點子的？

ex.en: You have to put up with all this noise.
ex.zh: 你必須忍受這些噪音。

ex.en: I have a meeting this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我今天下午有個會議。

ex.en: Sales were strong this quarter.
ex.zh: 本季銷售表現強勁。

ex.en: I didn't expect it to be this hard.
ex.zh: 我沒想到會這麼難。

ex.en: Is it always this busy here?
ex.zh: 這裡總是這麼忙嗎？

ex.en: I'll meet you there at six.
ex.zh: 我六點在那裡跟你碰面。

ex.en: Put the box over there.
ex.zh: 把箱子放在那邊。

ex.en: There is a pair of scissors on the desk.
ex.zh: 書桌上有一把剪刀。

ex.en: There is a garden in front of the house.
ex.zh: 房子前面有一座花園。

ex.en: Is there anything you want that you don't have?
ex.zh: 有什麼你想要卻還沒有的東西嗎？

ex.en: The doctor thought the patient's pulse was rather rapid.
ex.zh: 醫生認為病人的脈搏有點快。

ex.en: I think we should leave now.
ex.zh: 我覺得我們現在應該走了。

ex.en: You were just listening to the talk, without thinking.
ex.zh: 你只是在聽講，沒有思考。

ex.en: Let me think about it.
ex.zh: 讓我想一想。

ex.en: I can't think of her name.
ex.zh: 我想不起她的名字。

ex.en: Can you think of a better idea?
ex.zh: 你能想出更好的點子嗎？

think.zh: think over / think about doing：仔細考慮

ex.en: I'm thinking about changing jobs.
ex.zh: 我在考慮換工作。

ex.en: Think it over before you decide.
ex.zh: 決定前先好好考慮一下。

ex.en: I wish you had told me the truth then.
ex.zh: 真希望你當時就告訴我真相。

ex.en: It wasn't until then that I felt really frightened.
ex.zh: 直到那時，我才真正感到害怕。

ex.en: First check your email, then call the client.
ex.zh: 先看一下電子郵件，然後打電話給客戶。

ex.en: We had dinner and then went to a movie.
ex.zh: 我們吃完晚餐，然後去看了電影。

ex.en: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
ex.zh: 如果你發現錯誤，那就請幫忙改正。

ex.en: If you're tired, then take a break.
ex.zh: 如果你累了，那就休息一下。

ex.en: I see him in the library now and then.
ex.zh: 我偶爾會在圖書館看到他。

ex.en: He still comes to see me now and then.
ex.zh: 他仍然偶爾會來看我。

ex.en: Few things give us as much pleasure as music.
ex.zh: 很少有東西能像音樂一樣帶給我們這麼多快樂。

ex.en: Put your things in the locker.
ex.zh: 把你的東西放進置物櫃。

ex.en: You don't need to worry about such a thing.
ex.zh: 你不必擔心這種事。

ex.en: I cannot bring myself to do such a thing.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法讓自己做這種事。

ex.en: Why can't you take things just as they are?
ex.zh: 你為什麼不能接受事情原本的樣子呢？

ex.en: How are things at work?
ex.zh: 工作上一切還好嗎？

ex.en: The river that flows through London is the Thames.
ex.zh: 流經倫敦的河是泰晤士河。

ex.en: A blast of cold air swept through the house.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風吹過整棟房子。

ex.en: I left the window open all through the night.
ex.zh: 我整晚都開著窗戶。

ex.en: She worked through the weekend.
ex.zh: 她整個週末都在工作。

ex.en: I found the job through a friend.
ex.zh: 我透過朋友找到這份工作。

ex.en: You can pay through the app.
ex.zh: 你可以透過這個 App 付款。

ex.en: His courage will carry him through this difficult job.
ex.zh: 他的勇氣會幫他撐過這項艱難的工作。

ex.en: We got through the crisis together.
ex.zh: 我們一起度過了這場危機。

ex.en: Though he had a cold, he went to work.
ex.zh: 他雖然感冒了，還是去上班。

ex.en: Though very busy, she came to see me off.
ex.zh: 她雖然很忙，還是來送我。

ex.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
ex.zh: 他們雖然結婚了，卻分房睡。

ex.en: Even though it was raining, we went out.
ex.zh: 儘管在下雨，我們還是出門了。

ex.en: He went on talking as though nothing had happened.
ex.zh: 他繼續說，好像什麼事都沒發生過。

ex.en: He speaks as though he were afraid of something.
ex.zh: 他說話的樣子好像在害怕什麼。

ex.en: Seriously though, episode 21 made me almost cry while laughing.
ex.zh: 不過說真的，第21集讓我笑到快哭了。

ex.en: The hotel was nice. The food was bad, though.
ex.zh: 飯店很好，不過餐點很糟。

ex.en: Tom thanked me for the gift.
ex.zh: 湯姆謝謝我送他禮物。

ex.en: Thank you for the present you gave my son.
ex.zh: 謝謝你送我兒子禮物。

ex.en: I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.
ex.zh: 沒有你我做不到，謝謝你。

ex.en: Many thanks for your help.
ex.zh: 非常感謝你的幫忙。

ex.en: Please give my thanks to your team.
ex.zh: 請代我向你的團隊致謝。

ex.en: Thanks to a cold summer, beer has sold poorly.
ex.zh: 因為夏天涼爽，啤酒賣得不好。

ex.en: Thanks to your advice, I passed the exam.
ex.zh: 多虧你的建議，我通過了考試。

ex.en: They have a growing population; therefore they need more and more food.
ex.zh: 他們的人口不斷增加，因此需要越來越多糧食。

ex.en: Therefore, other people's ways of thinking might not be suited to you.
ex.zh: 因此，別人的思考方式不一定適合你。

ex.en: I think, therefore I am.
ex.zh: 我思故我在。

ex.en: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.
ex.zh: 中國幅員遼闊，因此茶的種類繁多。

ex.en: The flight was delayed, thus we missed the meeting.
ex.zh: 班機延誤，因此我們錯過了會議。

ex.en: The new system is faster and thus saves money.
ex.zh: 新系統比較快，因此能省錢。

ex.en: I asked the boy to throw the ball back.
ex.zh: 我請那個男孩把球丟回來。

ex.en: He threw a piece of meat to a dog.
ex.zh: 他丟了一塊肉給狗。

ex.en: Don't throw away this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌別丟，我還沒看。

ex.en: Don't throw away the receipt.
ex.zh: 收據別丟掉。

ex.en: We're throwing a party Friday evening at our place.
ex.zh: 我們星期五晚上在家裡辦派對。

ex.en: Let's throw a surprise party for Amy.
ex.zh: 我們幫 Amy 辦個驚喜派對吧。

ex.en: There are beautiful flowers scattered throughout the garden.
ex.zh: 美麗的花朵散布在整個花園裡。

ex.en: She cried throughout the night.
ex.zh: 她哭了一整夜。

ex.en: It rained throughout the day.
ex.zh: 雨下了一整天。

ex.en: I have supported you throughout.
ex.zh: 我自始至終都支持你。

ex.en: His action throughout was correct.
ex.zh: 他的行為從頭到尾都是正確的。

ex.en: Air pollution will be a threat to our survival.
ex.zh: 空氣汙染將威脅我們的生存。

ex.en: We thought his threat was only a joke.
ex.zh: 我們以為他的威脅只是開玩笑。

ex.en: I am not in the least afraid of his threats.
ex.zh: 我一點都不怕他的威脅。

ex.en: Are there any movie theaters near here?
ex.zh: 這附近有電影院嗎？

ex.en: The movie theater has discounts every Monday and Wednesday.
ex.zh: 那家電影院每週一和週三有折扣。

ex.en: We go to the theater once every two weeks.
ex.zh: 我們每兩週去一次劇院。

ex.en: Did Tom ever threaten you?
ex.zh: 湯姆威脅過你嗎？

ex.en: No point in threatening me. I'll still tell you nothing.
ex.zh: 威脅我也沒用，我什麼都不會說。

ex.en: The workers threatened to go on strike.
ex.zh: 工人們揚言要罷工。

ex.en: Climate change threatens many species.
ex.zh: 氣候變遷危及許多物種。

ex.en: A storm is threatening the east coast.
ex.zh: 一場暴風雨可能侵襲東岸。

ex.en: What is the theme of his latest novel?
ex.zh: 他最新小說的主題是什麼？

ex.en: The theme of this year's conference is innovation.
ex.zh: 今年研討會的主題是創新。

theme.zh: （作修飾）主題的（theme park 主題樂園、theme song 主題曲）

ex.en: Is this an anime theme song?
ex.zh: 這首是動漫主題曲嗎？

ex.en: We went to a theme park in Japan.
ex.zh: 我們去了日本的一座主題樂園。

ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.
ex.zh: 冰太薄了，撐不住你的重量。

ex.en: Cut the bread into thin slices.
ex.zh: 把麵包切成薄片。

ex.en: He seemed to be getting thinner every day.
ex.zh: 他好像一天比一天瘦。

ex.en: It seems he's gotten thinner lately.
ex.zh: 他最近好像瘦了。

ex.en: The higher we go up, the thinner the air becomes.
ex.zh: 我們爬得越高，空氣就越稀薄。

ex.en: This soup is a bit thin.
ex.zh: 這湯有點稀。

thin.zh: through thick and thin：同甘共苦、不論順境逆境

ex.en: She stayed by his side through thick and thin.
ex.zh: 不論順境逆境，她都陪在他身邊。

ex.en: Good friends stick together through thick and thin.
ex.zh: 好朋友會同甘共苦。

ex.en: She was wearing a thick coat against the chill.
ex.zh: 她穿了件厚外套禦寒。

ex.en: That book is thick, but it's not very expensive.
ex.zh: 那本書很厚，但不太貴。

ex.en: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.
ex.zh: 冰厚到我可以在上面走。

ex.en: The thick fog made it hard to see the road.
ex.zh: 濃霧讓人很難看清道路。

ex.en: This sauce is too thick, so add some water.
ex.zh: 這醬汁太濃了，加點水吧。

thick.zh: through thick and thin：同甘共苦、不論順境逆境

ex.en: She stayed by his side through thick and thin.
ex.zh: 無論順境逆境，她都陪在他身邊。

ex.en: Good friends stick together through thick and thin.
ex.zh: 好朋友會同甘共苦。

ex.zh: 近幾年職能治療的需求急速增加。

ex.en: She is getting physical therapy for her back.
ex.zh: 她正在接受背部的物理治療。

ex.en: He started going to therapy last year.
ex.zh: 他去年開始接受心理治療。

ex.en: Therapy helped her deal with stress.
ex.zh: 心理治療幫助她面對壓力。

ex.en: Do you have a fever and a sore throat?
ex.zh: 你有發燒和喉嚨痛嗎？

ex.en: I got a fish bone stuck in my throat.
ex.zh: 我喉嚨被魚刺卡住了。

ex.en: Tom cleared his throat and continued to speak.
ex.zh: 湯姆清了清喉嚨，繼續說下去。

ex.en: The Greeks invented a theoretical model of geometry.
ex.zh: 希臘人創立了幾何學的理論模型。

ex.en: The course covers both theoretical and practical skills.
ex.zh: 這門課涵蓋理論與實務技能。

ex.en: The risk is only theoretical at this point.
ex.zh: 目前這個風險只存在於理論上。

ex.en: Do you have a drink to help quench my thirst?
ex.zh: 你有什麼喝的可以讓我解渴嗎？

ex.en: I'm dying of thirst.
ex.zh: 我快渴死了。

ex.en: He has a thirst for adventure.
ex.zh: 他渴望冒險。

ex.en: Her thirst for knowledge impressed her teachers.
ex.zh: 她的求知慾讓老師們印象深刻。

ex.en: Students must prove the theorem.
ex.zh: 學生必須證明這個定理。

ex.en: The Pythagorean theorem is taught in middle school.
ex.zh: 畢氏定理是國中教的。

ex.en: She is a leading theorist in economics.
ex.zh: 她是經濟學界的頂尖理論家。

ex.en: Management theorists have studied this problem for decades.
ex.zh: 管理理論學者已經研究這個問題好幾十年了。

ex.en: The atomic reactor generates enormous amounts of thermal energy.
ex.zh: 核子反應爐會產生大量熱能。

ex.en: Thermal cameras can detect body heat.
ex.zh: 熱像儀能偵測體溫。

ex.en: Wear thermal underwear when you go skiing.
ex.zh: 去滑雪時要穿保暖內衣。

ex.en: I bought thermal gloves for the winter.
ex.zh: 我買了冬天用的保暖手套。

ex.en: Measure the thickness of the wall.
ex.zh: 量一下牆的厚度。

ex.en: The glass is two centimeters in thickness.
ex.zh: 這塊玻璃厚兩公分。

ex.zh: 紅線和白線，哪個比較好？

ex.zh: 我用絲線縫了這件洋裝。

ex.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
ex.zh: 我的手抖得太厲害，沒辦法穿針。

ex.zh: 你可以幫我穿這根針嗎？

ex.en: I lost the thread of the conversation.
ex.zh: 我跟不上對話的脈絡了。

ex.en: Please reply in the same email thread.
ex.zh: 請在同一個郵件串裡回覆。

ex.en: There will be thunderstorms in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 午後會有雷陣雨。

ex.en: We stayed inside during the thunderstorm.
ex.zh: 雷雨期間我們都待在室內。

ex.en: The nurse took his temperature with a thermometer.
ex.zh: 護士用溫度計量了量他的體溫。

ex.en: The thermometer reads 10 degrees.
ex.zh: 溫度計指向十度。

ex.en: The thermometer fell to zero last night.
ex.zh: 昨夜溫度計顯示氣溫下降到零度。

ex.en: The theologian wrote several books on the history of the church.
ex.zh: 那位神學家寫了幾本有關教會歷史的書。

ex.en: She is a respected theologian at the university.
ex.zh: 她是這所大學中受人敬重的神學家。

ex.en: I am thankful to have been given the experience of life.
ex.zh: 我很感激我能夠領受到這樣的人生體驗。

ex.en: We are thankful for your help.
ex.zh: 我們很感謝你的幫忙。

ex.en: She was thankful that nobody was hurt.
ex.zh: 她慶幸沒有人受傷。

thrilling.zh: 令人激動的、驚險刺激的

ex.en: Riding a horse is really thrilling.
ex.zh: 騎馬真的很令人興奮。

ex.en: It was a thrilling match that went into extra time.
ex.zh: 那是一場進入延長賽的緊張刺激的比賽。

ex.en: The roller coaster ride was thrilling.
ex.zh: 雲霄飛車很刺激。

ex.en: The nurse gave the baby an injection in the thigh.
ex.zh: 護理師在嬰兒的大腿上打了一針。

ex.en: He pulled a muscle in his thigh while running.
ex.zh: 他跑步時拉傷了大腿肌肉。

ex.en: She works as a massage therapist.
ex.zh: 她是按摩師。

ex.en: My physical therapist taught me exercises for my back.
ex.zh: 我的物理治療師教我一些背部的運動。

ex.en: She talks to a therapist once a week about her stress.
ex.zh: 她每週找治療師談一次她的壓力。

ex.en: The doctor ordered a blood test to check my thyroid.
ex.zh: 醫生安排抽血檢查我的甲狀腺。

ex.en: Her thyroid problem makes her feel tired all the time.
ex.zh: 她的甲狀腺問題讓她總是覺得很累。

ex.en: Swimming has a therapeutic effect on back pain.
ex.zh: 游泳對背痛有療效。

ex.en: Many people find gardening therapeutic after a stressful week.
ex.zh: 很多人覺得在忙碌的一週後種花種菜很療癒。

ex.en: The new system doubled our throughput.
ex.zh: 新系統讓我們的處理量增加了一倍。

ex.en: Network throughput drops when many users are online.
ex.zh: 很多使用者同時上線時，網路傳輸量會下降。

ex.en: The policeman took the thief by the arm.
ex.zh: 警察抓著小偷的胳膊。

ex.en: Watch out for thieves around here.
ex.zh: 在這附近當心小偷。

ex.en: The thief got away with the money.
ex.zh: 小偷帶著錢逃跑了。
